automation_name: AI Dev Wiki Topic News Collector

cutoff_window.rule: Public sources must display an unambiguous publication or update date within the prior 48 hours. Date-only sources at the lower boundary are excluded.

qualifying_updates.title: CodeQL changes for macOS 27, Xcode 27, and Swift 6.4
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub reports that CodeQL cannot support traced extraction when Xcode 27 is installed for C/C++, C#, Go, Java, Kotlin, or Swift; macOS 27 can also prevent traced extraction, and Swift 6.4 is unsupported on every platform. It advises pinning workflows to macOS/Xcode 26 or earlier, or using build mode none for C/C++, C#, and Java where appropriate.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: An agent-generated toolchain or runner upgrade can silently reduce a security-verification surface. Treat runner image, compiler/toolchain, CodeQL build mode, and supported-language coverage as versioned evaluation inputs; test the intended scan path after changes and require explicit approval for any coverage trade-off.
qualifying_updates.follow_up: Route to normal raw ingest only if a maintainer wants a durable scan-coverage change-control checklist; keep GitHub, CodeQL, and platform-specific compatibility facts upstream.
